items.title: Wardel Quezergue Interview, 1995-10-25
items.q: there was a musician and a piano player, Joe Broussard, the piano player, he was limited in his chord structure... So you hear things like that and you say, well let's try this and let's try that

ctx.x: Well, when you, when you get a song and you get it by inexperienced people, you have to do some changes because the changes are raw, you know, it's not really put together as such. It's got a little form to it but changes why the guys, the guys that rolled it, there was a musician and a piano player, Joe Broussard, the piano player, he was limited in his chord structure, you know. So you hear things like that and you say, well let's try this and let's try that, you know, and that's how that is. The same way with…
